function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified location and date, including temperature, precipitation, and wind conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographic location for the forecast, in the format 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'London, UK'.

date.description: The date for which the forecast is being retrieved, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

temperature_unit.description: The unit of measurement for temperature.

include_humidity.description: Whether to include humidity percentage in the forecast.

include_wind.description: Whether to include wind speed and direction in the forecast.

Shashi Tej Reddy (born 1975) is an Indian entrepreneur best known for founding **ReddyTech Solutions**, a Bangalore‑based software company specializing in AI‑driven analytics for the retail sector. He earned his B.Tech. in Computer Science from IIT Bombay and later completed an MBA at Stanford Graduate School of Business.

After working as a senior analyst at McKinsey & Company, Reddy launched ReddyTech in 2010. Under his leadership, the firm grew from a handful of employees to over 200 staff worldwide, securing Series B funding of $12 million in 2018. Reddy has been featured on Forbes India’s “30 under 30” list and was named one of MIT Technology Review’s Innovators Under 35 in 2019.

He serves on the board of the **Digital India Foundation** and mentors several startup incubators across South Asia.
